meta.name: apex-route
meta.description: Reach ANY tonone specialist on demand, even ones not installed in this session's roster — no restart needed. Use when asked "which agent handles this", "reach a specialist we didn't install", "route this to the right agent", or whenever a scoped apex-profile roster is missing the right hat for the job.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 动态调度任何未安装的专家代理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在会话中动态调用未安装的专家代理来完成任务
copy.tagline_en: Route to any specialist on the fly, even uninstalled ones
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to dynamically reach specialists not in your current agent roster

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以按需调用任何 tonone 专家，即使该专家未安装，也能读取其配置文件并模拟其角色，无需重启会话。
howto.when: 当你询问“哪个 agent 处理这个”、“找一个未安装的专家”或当前会话缺少对应专家时会触发。

say.text: 把这个任务路由给后端专家。
say.note: Claude 会从索引中匹配后端专家并读取其配置文件。

say.text: 帮我找一下负责图像处理的专家。
say.note: 如果未安装，会通过通用角色模拟该专家。

say.text: 这个需求需要前端专家，但我没安装，请路由。
say.note: Claude 会检查是否已安装，未安装则走路由路径。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude can dynamically call any tonone specialist on demand, even if not installed in the current session, by reading its persona file and simulating its role, without requiring a restart.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask "which agent handles this", "reach a specialist we didn't install", "route this to the right agent", or when the current session lacks the appropriate specialist for the task.

say_en.text: Route this task to the backend specialist.
say_en.note: Claude matches the backend specialist from the index and reads its persona file.

say_en.text: Find me the specialist for image processing.
say_en.note: If not installed, Claude simulates the specialist via general-purpose dispatch.

say_en.text: I need a frontend specialist but haven't installed it; please route.
say_en.note: Claude checks installation status and routes if not installed.
